x: John Hobbs, Martin Lake, Gary Pitts and Mike Webb all acquitted themselves well at this their first taste of the big time. They should be well fired up for next year.

In September's race it was the turn of Gary Pitts to score with 3rd in 9:49. Steve Halliday clocked 4:11 for the Leeds City Open Mile on August 11th but this was just a pipe opener for the Almondbury 10k at Huddersfield a week later.
